description:
Explore your Omnisend campaign data with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to review sends, opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, and unsubscribes.

Compare campaigns started during selected date ranges, review campaign open and click rates, and inspect available device and A/B test results. Engagement figures reflect the campaign results available when the report is retrieved.

Turn your campaign data into clear reports and compare performance across reporting periods.

positive.description: Campaign count and sends. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to workspace Omnisend Demo and its connected ILASHSG account. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Use [D-31, D-2] for the recent 30 days and [D-61, D-32] for the preceding 30 days, both inclusive. Recalculate dates at review time; expected values must come from returned rows, not historical preparation notes. Run cases one at a time. The provider can rate-limit concurrent requests; if that happens, record a blocked attempt and retry later rather than treating it as zero data.
positive.prompt: How many Omnisend campaigns started in the 30 days ending two days ago in Omnisend Demo, and how many messages did they send?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and choose workspace_name=Omnisend Demo. Discover fields using list_metrics_and_breakdowns_omnisend, then call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields in assorted_requests.omnisend_request. Do not call preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history or unrelated context. Read model-visible reportingData.Omnisend.data, table names, headers, date segments and note_of_assumption. Match columns by header. Campaign selection uses the date part of each campaign startDate; engagement is accumulated campaign results at retrieval, not necessarily events occurring inside the interval. Show actual dates. Errors are not successful execution or zero activity. Do not fabricate rows or silently replace missing values with zero. Request metrics=[Number of campaigns, Campaign sends], breakdowns=[]. Use date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]] and no time_granularity. Read Combined and show the campaign count and total sends. Do not call sends unique subscribers, delivered messages, or confirmed emails without channel evidence. Number of campaigns counts campaigns with a start date in the interval; it does not describe all drafts or automations in the account.
